walkthroughs.body_html:
Independent Research Project — a core area of A-Level French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Independent Research Project brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Independent Research Project.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which auxiliary does 'se marier' take in the passé composé?
options: avoir
être
aller
faire
nuclear family
extended family
blended family
single-parent family

mcqs.q: How do you say 'my house' in French?
options: Mon maison.
Mes maison.
Either is fine in modern French.
Ma maison.

mcqs.q: When meeting a teacher or stranger for the first time, do you use 'tu' or 'vous'?
options: Either is fine in modern French.
Vous - the formal/polite form.
Je vais visite Paris.
Tu, because it's singular and you're talking to one person.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I am going to visit Paris' (near future) in French?
options: Je vais à visiter Paris.
Je vais visiter Paris.
Either is fine in modern French.
Je vais visite Paris.
